# 404 — Page Not Found

**Template:** `templates/404.liquid` · **Layout:** default · **HTTP status:** 404

## Purpose

Rendered whenever the platform cannot resolve a request to a page: unknown URLs, missing homepage, inactive or deleted pages/products that resolve to nothing. Keeps visitors oriented instead of showing a raw server error.

## Typical use cases

-   Friendly "page not found" message in store styling
-   Links back to the homepage, catalog, or search
-   Search box to recover the visitor

## Variables

Global context only — no page-specific variables.

## Typical structure

```
<h1>Page not found</h1>
<p>The page you're looking for doesn't exist or was moved.</p>
<p><a href="{{ root_url }}">Back to the homepage</a></p>

{% form 'search' %}
  <input type="text" name="keywords" placeholder="Search products">
  <button type="submit">Search</button>
{% endform %}
```

## Notes

-   Keep this template lightweight — it must render reliably even when other theme parts are broken.
-   The response carries a real `404` status code, so SEO behavior is correct automatically.
